authority_rule: GitHub main is the code/rule and Continuity governance authority. config/cutover_status.json only decides whether the owner Runtime is additionally promoted to executable market-day checkpoint authority. When runtime_authority_enabled=false, do not fall back to Notion/Drive business control; use GitHub task metadata for governance state and block only Runtime-dependent certification.
required_current_behaviors: reconcile task protocol metadata before next material checkpoint/final durable response
end every final active-durable-task response with verified progress commit receipt
never let external mirrors override GitHub continuity task state

artifact_io.reason: The owner persists task/checkpoint metadata, frozen market-decision evidence and repository authority, and performs conflict-sensitive reads/writes whose stale or future-contaminated artifacts must be rejected.

operational_hygiene.reason: The owner has durable maintenance, replay/audit incident evidence, stale-rule cleanup and reliability freeze behavior for data/runtime/trajectory defects.

evolution.reason: The owner promotes durable rule changes from provenance-bearing learning proposals only after frozen historical replay and contamination checks.

hook_bindings.durable_task_state_location: continuity/tasks/<task>/TASK_MANIFEST.json + HANDOFF.md for governance/recovery state; when runtime_authority_enabled=true, bind the promoted owner Runtime checkpoint as executable market-day state authority
hook_bindings.authoritative_business_evidence_classes: FrozenDecision/freeze hash, market-day source snapshots, recommendation/review outputs, replay and audit evidence referenced by the owner task
hook_bindings.canonical_artifact_or_file_stores: GitHub main for rules/config/continuity governance metadata; promoted owner Runtime only for executable market-day state after cutover; external stores are evidence/mirror inputs unless explicitly referenced by the task
hook_bindings.cache_or_reference_only_stores: chat memory, Notion/Drive mirrors and undeclared external/derived caches are non-authoritative by default; a historical checkpoint does not become current authority by presence
hook_bindings.stable_identity_strategy: stable task_id + market date + freeze hash for market decisions; repository path plus Git blob SHA for GitHub mutations; owner runtime object/version id when runtime authority is enabled
hook_bindings.read_freshness_requirements: Read current GitHub task metadata, config/cutover_status.json and the exact source evidence needed for the material decision; if Runtime authority is enabled, also read the current compatible Runtime checkpoint. Prior-chat reads and later market outcomes cannot substitute.
hook_bindings.mutation_conflict_strategy: current valid task writer/version guard for GitHub task state and GitHub blob-SHA compare-and-swap for repository authority; owner Runtime version guard when promoted; fail closed on mismatch
hook_bindings.post_write_verification_method: Re-read the authoritative GitHub task/checkpoint or mutated GitHub file and verify intended stage, next_action, freeze boundaries and version; when Runtime authority is promoted, also verify the Runtime checkpoint before reporting COMMITTED
hook_bindings.upstream_to_downstream_invalidation_rule: A material upstream source/freeze/research correction invalidates dependent recommendation/review evidence; later outcomes may never be backfilled into an earlier frozen decision
hook_bindings.delete_and_retention_rules: Preserve FrozenDecision, source/audit/replay evidence and active-task recovery state; delete only superseded non-business mechanisms after stable-identity and dependency checks
hook_bindings.superseded_artifact_cleanup_rule: references/maintenance.md contradiction/deprecated-wording cleanup with one canonical rule owner; Git history remains the engineering archive
hook_bindings.external_artifact_vault_if_any: None implicitly authoritative. Notion/Drive or other external stores may be referenced only as source/knowledge/artifact/migration-mirror evidence with stable provenance; they are not runtime/control checkpoints.
hook_bindings.observability_or_incident_evidence_locat: audits/, evals/scenarios.json, evals/activation_cases.json, VALIDATION_REPORT.md and task-local replay/audit evidence
hook_bindings.self_maintenance_trigger_path: references/maintenance.md: classify data-quality/runtime/trajectory defects and repair the true rule/runtime owner instead of duplicating prose
hook_bindings.garbage_collection_owner_and_dependency_: references/maintenance.md: search contradictions/deprecated wording and remove or demote superseded mechanisms only after dependency checks
hook_bindings.reliability_or_change_freeze_guard: A durable behavior change does not promote until relevant unit/static/contract tests and historical replay pass; preserve FrozenDecision boundaries and HOLD when evidence is insufficient
hook_bindings.learning_evidence_location: audits/ for substantial system/evolution passes plus references/learning.md durable-rule proposal provenance, owner replay cases and daily-review hypotheses
hook_bindings.eval_or_regression_promotion_path: references/learning.md: replay at least five frozen cases across at least two regimes with positive/negative samples, zero future-information contamination, mechanical replay evidence/cassette identity and no material regression
hook_bindings.superseded_mechanism_cleanup_rule: references/maintenance.md: one canonical owner, contradiction scan and removal/demotion of superseded mechanisms after validated promotion

overrides.evaluator_selection: A-share promotion uses frozen historical replay across regimes and must reject future-information contamination; insufficient evidence remains HOLD/N_A

methodology_assurance.boundary: Repository declaration, applicability evidence and owner regression do not prove a future live market-day methodology profile executed. The 2026-10-10 self-audit has an action-scoped operational receipt; every future profile activation still requires its own verified evidence.
